item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14 compares the digests with !=.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated, and raw prefix matching can authorize paths outside a root.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 accepts a path beginning with services/api under root services/api, including services/api-evil/config.py; it also performs no normalization checks.","claim_ids":["x2","x3"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are never checked.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 reads only change[\"path\"], so an out-of-scope from_path can be renamed into scope.","claim_ids":["x4"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Unknown actions and an empty root set are not rejected consistently, and malformed records can raise instead of returning False.","evidence":"release_policy.py:17-19 ignores action, returns True for empty changes even when roots are empty, and indexes change[\"path\"] without validation.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
